issue.title: Failure to remove VLAN in CRM test

failure.body:
**Description**
It looks like the CRM tests fail consistently on some testbeds due to being unable to remove a VLAN. It looks like this is simply because orchagent tries to process the VLAN removal event before the member removal event, triggering a few log messages before the member gets removed and the VLAN is successfully removed.

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1. Run test_crm against master image

**Describe the results you received:**
```
raise LogAnalyzerError(result)
E           LogAnalyzerError: {'match_messages': {'/tmp/syslog.2021-01-25-<IPV6>': ['Jan 25 <IPV6>.231022 str2-7050cx3-acs-01 ERR swss#orchagent: :- removeVlan: Failed to remove non-empty VLAN Vlan2\n', 'Jan 25 <IPV6>.233296 str2-7050cx3-acs-01 ERR swss#orchagent: :- removeVlan: Failed to remove non-empty VLAN Vlan2\n']}, 'total': {'expected_match': 0, 'expected_missing_match': 0, 'match': 2}, 'match_files': {'/tmp/syslog.2021-01-25-<IPV6>': {'expected_match': 0, 'match': 2}}, 'expect_messages': {'/tmp/syslog.2021-01-25-<IPV6>': []}, 'unused_expected_regexp': []}
```

**Describe the results you expected:**
Test should pass.

resolution.title: [crm] Ignore error messages for removing non-empty VLAN
resolution.description:
Signed-off-by: Danny Allen <<EMAIL>>

### Description of PR

Summary: [crm] Ignore error messages for removing non-empty VLAN
Fixes https://github.com/Azure/sonic-mgmt/issues/2871

### Type of change

- [x] Bug fix
- [ ] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement)
- [ ] Test case(new/improvement)

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
We noticed in https://github.com/Azure/sonic-mgmt/issues/2871 that even though the CRM test queues up VLAN updates in sequential order, the member removal can still happen after the VLAN removal. As expected, orchagent emits a failure log and retries the VLAN removal later, but this can cause issues in the test.

#### How did you do it?
Added a loganalyzer exception for VLAN removal errors.

#### How did you verify/test it?
Re-ran the test on a DUT in the lab. Noted the error message in the syslog, but the test was still able to pass.

#### Any platform specific information?
n/a

#### Supported testbed topology if it's a new test case?
n/a

### Documentation

n/a
